race.comment: PRINCE MAGNETITE (2) hails from the Hawkes stable, and he looks the one to beat fourth up from a spell. He drops in class, and is still well placed at the weights, so with Todd Pannell in the irons, he goes on top for us. MILLSY'S AWARD (1) overcame a wide draw to score a comfortable maiden win at Ballarat last time out when racing over this trip for the first time. He is expected to settle back again, and he only needs a genuine tempo up front, to be a winning threat in this. DAMELLI (6) has mixed her form in 4-starts this prep, and she would also benefit from a good pace up front. If she can settle in the running, then she will be right in the finish again. WHITE POINTER (4) was well rated in front when winning his debut as expected at Mildura just over 2 weeks ago. He skips a couple of grades for this, but has the scope to repeat the dose. TAN TAT GOLD (3) won his maiden late last year over 2050m, and has had a recent trial to get ready for his return. Watch for him late.
